speaker: Mr Desmond Choo
text: asked the Prime Minister in view of higher interest rates (a) whether there has been an increase in corporate bad debts; and (b) how does the Monetary Authority of Singapore ensure that SMEs continue to have access to capital to grow their businesses.

speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
text: NPL has fallen in the corporate sector and also in the SME segment.

speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
text: SME loan volumes themselves have, indeed, remained resilient over the past year, even as interest rates gradually rose.

speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
text: As Senior Minister of State Chee Hong Tat recently explained to this House on 4 October 2022, the Government helps businesses access capital to help grow their businesses through various credit schemes.

speaker: The Minister of State for Culture, Community and Youth and Trade and Industry (Mr Alvin Tan) (for the Prime Minister)
text: We will continue to monitor developments in this space.

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: The first one is, as we expect the overall interest rate environment to only increase and the cost of funds for companies to increase rather steeply both here and in the region, what is the forecast on NPLs, especially for the SMEs?

speaker: Mr Desmond Choo (Tampines)
text: My second clarification is, if and when we see a large number of companies facing insolvency, under what circumstances will the Government come in and assist such companies, especially the promising ones, to tide over a difficult period?

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: What is quite useful is to look at the corporate balance sheets, the health of the corporate balance sheets.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: Maybe I will just share a few useful data points.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: With regard to the second supplementary question, I mentioned earlier on that Senior Minister of State Chee Hong Tat had shared how the Government is also availing access to financing to the corporate sector as well as SMEs.

speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
text: In fact, NTUC's new Company Training Committee grant also helps SMEs to improve productivity as well as the quality of their workforce.
